en.description:
【Hooroo Game - Your Gamified Fitness & Motion Hub!】

Tired of sitting all day? Hate boring workouts? It’s time to change the way you move! Hooroo Game turns your iPhone and Apple Watch into a smart, gamified fitness arcade. No expensive consoles, no heavy sweat—just pure fun that keeps you active and helps you close your daily rings!

【AI-Powered Body Tracking】
Ditch the controllers! Prop up your phone, and our advanced AI camera will flawlessly track your full-body movements. Slash, jump, dodge, and dance your way through exciting mini-games using just your body.

【Live Heart Rate & Calorie Engine】
Sync your Apple Watch to unlock the ultimate fitness feedback. Your real-time heart rate (BPM) and estimated calories burned are displayed directly on the screen. The faster your heart beats, the more intense the visual effects become!

【Bite-Sized Workouts for Every Mood】
Whether you need a 3-minute office break to stretch your back, a stress-relief session, or a light cardio dance in your living room, our dynamic library has the perfect routine for you. Say goodbye to a sedentary lifestyle!

【Seamless Health Integration】
Make every move count. Hooroo Game seamlessly syncs your workout minutes and active calories with the Apple Health app. Closing your daily activity rings has never been this addictive.

【Big Screen Party Mode】
Ready for a family game night? Mirror your screen to the TV with one tap. Combine leisure, light cardio, and pure excitement right in your living room!

Think your Apple Watch is just a step counter? Think again. Download Hooroo Game now, turn on your camera, and discover the most joyful way to stay fit!



User Agreement: https://10m.com.cn/doc/browser/Terms_of_Services_en.html
Privacy Policy: https://10m.com.cn/doc/browser/Privacy_Policy_en.html
